description: Send a message to an account's paid inbox (reaches accounts that have not allowed you). `value` must be at least the recipient's inbox fee (see geode_messaging_get_account_settings_data); higher amounts rank higher. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

confirm_token.description: Token from the first call, to confirm this irreversible action

file_url.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

new_message.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

value.description: GEODE to send with this call (explicit; never inferred)

name: geode_messaging_send_paid_message
title: Messaging: send paid message
